# Support & Community Resources

Welcome to the **Jia Framework** community! Whether you are building an enterprise cyber defense stack or exploring AI prompt injection defense, we are here to help.

---

## ❓ How to Get Help

### 1. 📖 Documentation & Setup Guides
Before asking a question, please check our documentation:
- [System Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Performance Benchmarks](docs/BENCHMARKS.md)
- [Security Playbooks & Policy Setup](docs/SECURITY_PLAYBOOKS.md)
- [Interactive Cyber Command Dashboard Overview](README.md#-interactive-dashboard)

---

## 💬 Community Channels

- **GitHub Discussions**: Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/CharleGutierrez/jia/discussions) for general Q&A, setup assistance, design proposals, and feature ideas.
- **Bug Reports**: Found a reproducible bug? Open a [Bug Report](https://github.com/CharleGutierrez/jia/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Feature Requests**: Have an idea for a new module or SIEM integration? Open a [Feature Request](https://github.com/CharleGutierrez/jia/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security Disclosures**: Please see our [Security Policy](SECURITY.md) for private reporting.

---

## 🌟 Support Jia

If you find Jia useful in your organization, consider supporting the project:
- ⭐ **Star the Repository** on GitHub to increase visibility!
- 🔀 **Fork & Contribute** code, documentation, or tutorials.
- 📣 **Share** Jia on X/Twitter, LinkedIn, Hacker News, and Reddit!
